title: Minimum Deletions to Make Character Frequencies Unique
goal: Delete the fewest characters so all remaining positive character frequencies differ.
strategy: Process frequencies from largest to smallest. Keep each as high as possible below the previous kept frequency; zero means a character disappears and can repeat freely.
